steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each objective and resource is matched to a measure, a baseline and an owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 2 plan items need a measure or an owner

findings.title: Objective with no measure
findings.fix: Add a measure with its target

findings.title: Audit in the plan with no process
findings.fix: Name the process to be audited

outcome.notChecked: Market or customer requirements not in the notes.

pros: Checks an objective with no measure, a target with no baseline, an audit in the plan with no process, and a resource with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Market or customer requirements not in the notes.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-annual-quality-plan skill on the records for this review.
